record: National Register of Historic Places Daniel Boone Hotel
facts: The listed building stands at 405 Capitol Street in Charleston.
Former hotel at the northwest corner of Capitol and Washington Streets has a base, regular six-story middle shaft, a terra-cotta crown, and a U-shaped plan adapted for office use.
The surviving Daniel Boone Hotel is the ten-story blond brick building at 405 Capitol Street, built in 1927–1928.
